data.name: Ashiya
data.gender_notes: Ashiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ashiya is a name that signifies a person who is alive, well, and thriving. It is derived from the Arabic word 'ashiyaa', which means to live or be alive. The name Ashiya carries the meaning “Alive and well” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ashiya usually hope their child will grow to embody alive and well and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Ashiya is associated with the concept of life and vitality, which is a gift from Allah.
data.etymology: Ashiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Alive and well.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashiya total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_urdu.name: آشیا
